entries.title: Responsive sidebar examples
entries.description: All 13 Sidebar examples now adapt more cleanly across desktop and mobile layouts, with improved navigation states, accessible controls, and a refreshed workspace-focused variant.

entries.title: Deduplicated registry storage
entries.description: Registry releases now share identical source blobs, keeping future SpartanUI compatibility updates compact without removing historical versions.

entries.title: Grouped changelog categories
entries.description: Updates on the same date are grouped by change type, reducing repeated badges and making the timeline more compact.

entries.title: Grouped compatibility badges
entries.description: Each changelog date now shows its compatible SpartanUI version once, keeping individual update rows easier to scan.

entries.title: Unified date timeline
entries.description: Product updates and automatic component-source changes now appear together under their publication date.

entries.title: Date-based changelog
entries.description: SimUI changes are now tracked chronologically, independently from SpartanUI releases, while every entry still shows its compatible SpartanUI version.

entries.title: Consistent SpartanUI branding
entries.description: User-facing labels, compatibility messages, release history, and documentation now consistently use the SpartanUI name.

entries.title: Clean, remembered SpartanUI versions
entries.description: SimUI remembers your selected SpartanUI version without adding it to everyday browser URLs, while copied component links still include the version for accurate sharing.

entries.title: Clearer release cards
entries.description: Each changelog release received a distinct, responsive layout that separates curated highlights from automatic component-source changes.

entries.title: Repeatable registry publishing
entries.description: Registry snapshots can be regenerated for an existing SpartanUI version while keeping the versioned source and latest alias in sync.

entries.title: Registry release history
entries.description: Browse human-readable highlights and the complete component-level changes for every published registry version.

entries.title: Version-aware component source
entries.description: Choose a supported SpartanUI version in the SimUI header and copy component source that matches that release.

entries.title: Versioned registry baseline
entries.description: Established the first preserved SimUI component-source snapshot for a supported SpartanUI release.
